name: Bellevue Palace
positioning: Grand hotel in Bern that serves as the official guesthouse of the Swiss government, next door to the Federal Palace
best_for: Travelers who want a historic base beside the Swiss Federal Palace
Guests planning day trips from Bern to the Alps and lakes

facts.text: The hotel stands at Kochergasse 3-5 in Bern.
The Bellevue Palace has been a place of living history for over 150 years.
The hotel is a venue for diplomats and politicians and a common meeting hub for Bern.
Brasserie VUE serves a contemporary take on traditional brasserie dishes in a lounge-style atmosphere.
Le Lobby is a meeting place for informal snacks and drinks.
Noumi Bar & Grill offers signature drinks from the mixologist and lounge music, for lunch, after-work and casual dinners.
The Bellevue Bar is an established meeting place for business people, politicians, couples and bon viveurs.
Suites include a Deluxe Suite, a Tower Suite and a Presidential Suite.
Bern's old town, with its arcades and historic fountains, is a UNESCO World Heritage site.
In summer, the banks of the River Aare are a recreation area for strolling, jogging and swimming.

highlights.text: The Bellevue Palace is the official guesthouse of the Swiss government.
The hotel stands right next door to the Bundeshaus, the Federal Palace.
The hotel offers views of the Bernese Alps.
The Bellevue Bar has Le Fumoir, a room devoted to aficionados of fine tobacco.
Afternoon tea brings mini sandwiches, scones and petits fours presented on an etagere.

considerations.text: Wellness is a Finnish sauna with separate areas for men and women plus the Bellevie Gym, which has cardio and weight machines and a self-service gym bar.
Excursions such as the Jungfraujoch, a boat trip on Lake Thun or Gruyere Castle start from Bern rather than from the hotel's doorstep.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for a luxury heritage property and a traditional, formal atmosphere.
